subject.title: [Bug]: Hundreds of repeated HTTP requests to 169.254.169.254:80 for the first 10 minutes after the startup

question: Is https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90694 ready with source-backed and contributor live-output proof, or should it wait for exact-head NemoClaw sandbox plus EC2/ECS/default-chain proof before merge?
rationale: The linked PR targets the right code path and has sufficient-proof labeling, but it changes auth-provider IMDS/default-chain behavior that source tests cannot fully prove across real AWS credential environments.

options.title: Require live credential-mode proof
options.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox trace and one explicit Bedrock AWS default-chain credential run before merging the linked PR.

options.title: Accept source-backed proof after CI
options.body: Merge the linked PR after exact-head CI if maintainers accept the AWS SDK contract and focused tests as enough for this limited fix.

recommendation.title: Require live credential-mode proof
recommendation.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox trace and one explicit Bedrock AWS default-chain credential run before merging the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The current plugin-boundary refactor and prior Bedrock memory credential-gate history point to steipete as the best available decision owner for the compatibility/proof call.
